items.title: Liverpool defensive crisis deepens as little-known rule means wonderkid Ifeanyi Ndukwe can only play once more this YEAR
items.summary: LIVERPOOL wonderkid Ifeanyi Ndukwe will have to wait until 2027 to make his competitive debut - after failing to bag a work permit. The defender, 18, headed to Merseyside this summer despite a deal being agreed with Austria Wien in January. And Ndukwe has impressed new Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola,
